purpose: Typed, versioned context for a signed Portal scenario artifact. This contract describes existing MCD admission and evidence primitives; it does not contain upgrade-version logic or an installer recipe.

binding.semantics: Every receipt, retry and terminal result is bound to this tuple. Replaying the same idempotency_key may return the durable terminal receipt but must not execute the artifact twice.

application.path_semantics: root, console_path and php_bin are absolute paths declared by the verified host installation; MCD does not infer or replace them in this context.
application.console_semantics: console_path is the already discovered bin/console or app/console path for the selected root.
application.user_semantics: run_as_user is the existing application execution identity; no new default is defined here.

host_facts.digest_semantics: facts_digest is the existing applicability_facts_digest over the normalized facts mapping, excluding detector_schema only.

artifact.digest_semantics: digest and revision must equal the verified signed scenario_artifact pin; size is the exact delivered artifact byte length.

backup.precondition: The verified backup manifest is complete, current, bound to the selected root and instance, and its files/database assets have passed the existing MCD evidence checks before a mutating primitive begins.
backup.receipt_binding: backup evidence is bound to the same job/run/plan identity and is never replaced by caller-supplied size or hash fields.

reconcile.scope: only an already-in-schema identified version reported by the existing MCD reconciliation path

migration.policy: The contract carries the discovered command family and policy only; it does not select source or target upgrade versions.

rollback.primitive: existing immutable patch-plan reverse snapshot and backup restore mechanisms
rollback.semantics: Restore original file bytes and metadata, or remove a created file only when its current digest equals the recorded after digest; restore database rows only when their current value equals the recorded replacement. Drift, missing evidence or unknown dependent migration blocks rollback and fails closed.
rollback.idempotency: A completed rollback receipt is terminal for the bound run; a retry may verify the same state but must not apply a second unrelated rollback.

failure_behavior.receipt: persist a bounded typed failed receipt with the binding and failure stage; never persist secrets or raw artifact/context bytes
failure_behavior.unknown_state: unknown, interrupted or partially observed mutation requires rollback state attempted/failed or blocked; it is never reported succeeded
